name: The Children of Magia
summary:
Far away from all civilization there exists an Island teeming with mysteries and secrets; the Island of Tydes. The best Witch in the history of her college, Felicia sets out to uncover the mysteries of the island with the help of her conjured familiars.

You play as one of Felicia's familiars: Ruru! Using the power of magic bestowed upon her by Freya the Fairy... Ruru must aid Felicia in uncovering the secrets hidden on the island. The path ahead is sure to hold fierce battles, challenging labyrinths and difficult puzzles, but with your help Ruru will prevail
